info.title: Kodi JSON-RPC notifications
info.description: Server-initiated notifications of Kodi's JSON-RPC 2.0 API. Kodi pushes these over the WebSocket and raw TCP transports only; they are never delivered over HTTP. Request/response methods are documented separately in openrpc.json.

tcp.description: Raw TCP transport; newline-free JSON-RPC objects over a plain socket.

jsonrpc.description: The single JSON-RPC channel; every notification is delivered on it.

Player.OnPlay.name: Player.OnPlay
Player.OnPlay.summary: Playback of a media item has been started or the playback speed has changed. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnAVStart.name: Player.OnAVStart
Player.OnAVStart.summary: Playback of a media item has been started and first frame is available. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnAVChange.name: Player.OnAVChange
Player.OnAVChange.summary: Audio- or videostream has changed. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

Player.OnContentGeometryChange.name: Player.OnContentGeometryChange
Player.OnContentGeometryChange.summary: The picture rectangle in force has changed. Sent when playback starts, when a confirmed change occurs partway through a title, when the picture moves on the screen, and when playback ends - the last carrying the geometry of the GUI, because that is then what is on the screen. Carries the rectangles themselves, so that acting on them needs no further call. The picture moving is a change in its own right: an instruction can move it without changing what the content is, and a display mode switch or a resized window moves it with no instruction at all.

screen.description: Where Kodi drew that content, absent while nothing is drawn - which is the case for the announcement playback ends with.

Player.OnStop.name: Player.OnStop
Player.OnStop.summary: Playback of a media item has been stopped. If there is no ID available extra information will be provided.

end.description: Whether the player has reached the end of the playable item(s) or not

Player.OnPlaybackFailed.name: Player.OnPlaybackFailed
Player.OnPlaybackFailed.summary: Playback of a media item was requested but did not happen. Playback starts asynchronously, so a request that was answered successfully can still fail afterwards.

reason.description: Why the item was not played. "unplayable": no player could play it, or the player refused it. "unresolved": a plugin did not return a playable item. "locked": the master or media source lock refused it. "error": the player reported an error after playback had started.

Player.OnPropertiesChanged.name: Player.OnPropertiesChanged
Player.OnPropertiesChanged.summary: Properties of what is seen and heard changed, carrying only what changed. player is present when the change belongs to a playback.

Player.ScreenGeometry.description: Where Kodi actually put the picture, in screen pixels. This is what was done rather than what the content is: a raster and a maintained ratio together decide the rectangle, and neither of those ratios says where the picture landed. Present only while something is drawn.

picture.description: The content on the screen. Black bars coded into the video are outside it, as are the bars Kodi itself is showing around it - this is the lit rectangle, which is what a mask is driven to.

raster.description: The area Kodi is operating in, which the picture is contained by and never exceeds. This is what a lens is driven to, and it is not the picture whenever the content is narrower than the room.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en, en-AU), empty when the stream declares none, und where it declares one that names no language
BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en, en-AU), empty when the stream declares none, und where it declares one that names no language
BCP 47 language tag (e.g. en, en-AU), empty when the stream declares none, und where it declares one that names no language

displayOrder.description: The current entry's place in play order, which is list order unless shuffled

contentRect.description: The shape on the screen: the picture while something plays, and the shape Kodi rests at otherwise. Answered whether or not anything plays.

anyOf.description: An unknown item does not have any additional information.
An item known to the database has an identification.
A movie item has a title and may have a release year.
A tv episode has a title and may have an episode number, season number and the title of the show it belongs to.
A music video has a title and may have an album and an artist.
A song has a title and may have an album, an artist and a track number.
A picture has a file path.
A PVR channel is either a radio or tv channel and has a title.

Audio.Item.Kind.description: A kind of music library item, named by its media type

Audio.Item.description: A music library item, addressed by its kind and id

Video.Item.Kind.description: A kind of video library item, named by its media type

Video.Item.description: A video library item, addressed by its kind and id

Video.ContentRect.description: The picture within the frame, after pixel aspect correction. Black bars coded into the video are outside it. The rectangle is absent when there is no frame behind it, which is the case while nothing is playing and Kodi is reporting the shape it rests at; aspect, label and name are always present, and are what a consumer acting on the shape rather than on the pixels should read.

x.description: Absent when there is no frame behind the rectangle, along with the five below - which is the case while nothing is playing and Kodi is reporting the shape it rests at. A library row carries no rectangle at all until its file is measured, so it is never the shape this describes.

frameWidth.description: The whole frame, in the same space, which the rectangle is contained by

aspect.description: The ratio the content was shot at

label.description: Kodi's name for that ratio, empty when it corresponds to none

name.description: What that ratio is called, empty when it has no established name. Served beside label rather than instead of it, and never translated, so it can be compared against.

varies.description: The title changes shape partway through, so one rectangle cannot describe all of it

stale.description: Measured by a superseded detector, and served rather than discarded

rejected.description: A measurement existed and the plausibility gate refused it, so the frame is being served instead. The only thing that tells that apart from never having measured at all, which is otherwise identical: both report source container and both serve the frame. Which of the two it is decides whether the answer is to measure the file or to look at why detection failed on it.

source.description: container means nothing is known and the frame is the answer

sections.description: Every geometry the title was measured in, dominant first, in the same space and frame as the rectangle above. Present whatever decided the rectangle: a declared ratio pins the answer without erasing what was measured, and a measurement the plausibility gate refused is still what detection saw. Empty when nothing was measured, and when the answer is a live reading on a file no stored measurement retained the shapes of. This is what varies can be acted on with.

label.description: Kodi's name for that ratio, empty when it corresponds to none

name.description: What that ratio is called, empty when it has no established name
